description:
Finally, we work with heart. We are not here only for a prize. We are here because we love astronomy, we love science, and we want to prove students from Gujrat can compete globally. We will support each other, motivate each other and celebrate every small win together as one.
So, if you want to learn, grow and explore space, this team is for you. Join us. Let us build something amazing and represent UOG and Pakistan.
Your idea matters. Your voice matters. Your place is here with us.
